subject: Eval window preservation request — invoice in procurement queue
messages:
From: Kiran Shah <kiran@novocare.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Novocare Procurement <procurement@novocare.ai>, Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@novocare.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval window preservation request — invoice in procurement queue

Hi Logan,

Quick note from procurement — our finance team has the PO ready but invoicing is delayed because our vendor onboarding requires additional vendor verifications. The accounting queue told us it will be ~7–10 business days before they can raise the PO formally.

We are at a critical point in the eval: engineers need an extra week of dedicated capacity to finish integration tests. Can Redwood provide a short-term access allowance or temporary credits while our internal PO clears? If possible, something that keeps our sandbox running for 14 days would be ideal.

I've attached the draft PO for reference. Happy to share any procurement contact or the vendor questionnaire if that helps speed things up.

Thanks,
Kiran Shah
Head of Platform Engineering
Novocare

Attachment: Novocare_PO_draft_4567.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Kiran Shah <kiran@novocare.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window preservation request — invoice in procurement queue

Hi Kiran — thanks for the context and the PO draft. We can absolutely help avoid lost momentum on the integration.

Short plan: I can provision a temporary credit allowance contingent on a PO being routed and a procurement contact for invoicing. Sales ops will need a one-page acknowledgement from Novocare accepting the temporary credit terms (we keep it simple: credits expire in 30 days, non-refundable).

Before I escalate to Sales Ops, could you confirm:
- Estimated PO issue date (approx)
- Procurement contact (name + email) we should reference on the invoice
- Any compliance blocker (e.g., unusual payment terms) we should know about

Cc-ing Ben from Sales Ops to coordinate the temporary credit amount and sign-off.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Kiran Shah <kiran@novocare.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window preservation request — invoice in procurement queue

Hi Kiran — Ben from Sales Ops here. Appreciate the PO draft. We can approve a temporary credit to preserve the eval window while the PO clears, subject to the acknowledgement Logan mentioned.

Proposal (approved by Sales Ops lead):
- Temporary credit: $4,000 of platform credits applied to Novocare account
- Validity: 30 days from issuance
- Condition: Novocare signs the temporary-credit acknowledgement (attached) and provides a committed PO issue date within 10 business days

Next steps:
1) I'll upload the temporary-credit acknowledgement to DocuSign and send a link — signing confirms the terms above.
2) Once signed, we'll apply the credits and notify your team when resources are allocated.
3) When the PO is issued, we'll convert/offset credits against the invoice per standard terms.

Fyi: Marissa (CS) will coordinate capacity allocation with your engineering lead. Dev (technical account) is on standby if you need a quick config walkthrough.

Attachment: redwood_temp_credit_agreement.pdf

Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
From: Kiran Shah <kiran@novocare.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Novocare Procurement <procurement@novocare.ai>, Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@novocare.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval window preservation request — invoice in procurement queue

Ben / Logan — this is great, thank you. We accept the temporary credit proposal.

Aisha (cc) is our procurement lead — she will sign the acknowledgement in DocuSign and should have the PO finalized within 6 business days (team is prioritizing this). I will route the vendor questionnaire to your security contact separately.

Please proceed with the DocuSign link and apply the credits once completed; also confirm which account/email the credits will be applied to so I can ensure our engineers use the right workspace.

Thanks again — this will help us finish the integration tests without disruption.

Best,
Kiran

Attachment: Novocare_PO_draft_4567.pdf (re-attached)
